headline: An ADI patent publication discloses generalized ML prediction of power-electronic behavior
fact: U.S. patent application US20250335671A1, assigned to Analog Devices, discloses a generalized machine-learning model for predicting missing physical modalities of previously unseen power-electronic devices. Its examples map among transient responses, Bode plots, and circuit parameters using self-supervised pretraining and few-shot adaptation, and say the framework may extend to analog subsystems such as RF signal chains. This is a patent disclosure of surrogate behavior prediction, not evidence of product implementation, model accuracy, or deployment in a verification flow.

sources.title: US20250335671A1 — Predicting physical modalities of power electronic devices
sources.summary: The patent record identifies the October 30, 2025 publication, Analog Devices assignee, and the disclosed self-supervised and few-shot framework for predicting transient, frequency-domain, and circuit-parameter modalities.
